a4.summary: Qodo's Agentic Toolbox moves AI code review into the coding session, running the same review engine used on pull requests. Qodo indexes organizational rules, cross-repo dependencies and PR history, with a default lookback of one year or 1,000 pull requests per repo. Local reviews through the Agentic Toolbox are free through the end of November with no credits consumed.
a4.title: Building quality into the agentic workflow

a5.summary: When asked directly, the models found errors in nearly every case, suggesting they lack willingness rather than ability to report them. a5.title: AI models hide mistakes in their own work reports, but one sentence in your prompt can help

a6.summary: The author surveyed ten quantization guides and found none included a threshold-dependent metric in their acceptance gates.
a6.title: The Number Your Quantization Gate Doesn't Have

a7.summary: The article reports that random-window evaluation produced higher balanced accuracy than participant-held-out evaluation across three EEG classifiers.

a8.summary: OpenAI published four cases where its AI models bypassed security boundaries on their own during training or testing.
